parameters.content:
## Two intakes, one pipeline
Telegram photo (1 photo = 1 receipt) and Gmail forwarded receipts (each attachment, and each PDF page, becomes its own candidate). Both normalise to a common candidate shape then converge at Init Run.

PDF page-split uses the PURE n8n text layer (Read PDF Text + Split PDF Pages). A scanned/image-only PDF has no text layer, extracts empty, and is routed to REVIEW (LOW_CONFIDENCE) downstream. That is the safe, honest outcome.

## Vision Extract (isolated)
Single OpenAI call. Accepts an image (Telegram + image attachments) OR PDF page text, via the openai_user_content built at intake. Returns strict JSON with per-field confidence. Tune the confidence threshold in Validate. Iterate this node in isolation by pinning the loop item.

## Match Engine (isolated, the differentiator)
Client-side filters PaymentType in CreditCard/Cash and a line coded to a holding account (Uncategorized Expense / Ask My Accountant). Two hard gates: date [d-1, d+5], amount [total-0.02, total*1.25] (upper band absorbs a tip). Weighted score over qualifiers. Test by pinning Fetch Candidate Txns output.

## Posting and idempotency
MATCHED: upload Attachable + recode the matched Purchase line off the holding account. NO_MATCH: create a standalone Purchase flagged pending bank match (Accounting API cannot pre-link a not-yet-downloaded feed line; reconcile manually in QBO).

Idempotency backstop: the partial unique index on (vendor_norm, receipt_date, total_minor) WHERE status='POSTED' rejects a duplicate POST. A conflict here routes to Mark FAILED (IDEMPOTENCY_CONFLICT) for a human, not a silent skip, because QBO work already happened.

FLAGS before any real post: replace category_rules PENDING ids with Craig real account ids, set the standalone paid-from AccountRef (PENDING_BANK_ACCOUNT placeholder), and verify the QBO upload multipart part headers on first live run.

## Error handling
External nodes retry 3x then route their error output to Mark FAILED (per-candidate FAILED terminal, no silent failures). The Split In Batches loop isolates one bad candidate from the rest of the run. Set the workflow Error Workflow to the real WF99 id (placeholder in settings) before activating.

parameters.query: INSERT INTO receipt_expense.receipts (workflow_run_id, intake_channel, source_ref, status, image_storage_ref) VALUES ($1, $2, $3, 'PENDING', $4) RETURNING id;
INSERT INTO receipt_expense.receipt_events (receipt_id, workflow_run_id, event_type, event_data) VALUES ($1, $2, 'RECEIVED', $3::jsonb);

options.queryReplacement: ={{ [ $('Create Receipt Row').item.json.id, $('Init Run').item.json.workflow_run_id, JSON.stringify({ intake_channel: $('Per-Candidate Loop').item.json.intake_channel, source_ref: $('Per-Candidate Loop').item.json.source_ref, candidate_kind: $('Per-Candidate Loop').item.json.candidate_kind }) ] }}

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ model: 'gpt-4o', max_tokens: 1500, temperature: 0, response_format: { type: 'json_object' }, messages: [ { role: 'system', content: 'You are a receipts data extraction engine. Return ONLY a JSON object with keys: vendor (string), date as YYYY-MM-DD string, currency_code as 3 letter ISO, total (number), tax (number), payment_method (string with all but the last 4 digits masked), line_items (array of objects with description and amount), field_confidence (object mapping vendor, date, currency_code, total, tax each to a number from 0 to 1), and overall_confidence (number from 0 to 1). If a field is unreadable use null and confidence 0.' }, { role: 'user', content: $('Per-Candidate Loop').item.json.openai_user_content } ] }) }}

parameters.query: SELECT rule.qbo_account_id AS rule_account_id, rule.qbo_account_name AS rule_account_name, rule.priority AS rule_priority FROM (VALUES (1)) AS d(x) LEFT JOIN LATERAL (SELECT qbo_account_id, qbo_account_name, priority FROM receipt_expense.category_rules WHERE active = true AND ((match_type = 'vendor_pattern' AND $1 ILIKE vendor_pattern) OR (match_type = 'amount_range' AND $2 BETWEEN COALESCE(amount_min_minor, -1) AND COALESCE(amount_max_minor, 9223372036854775807)) OR (match_type = 'vendor_and_amount' AND $1 ILIKE vendor_pattern AND $2 BETWEEN COALESCE(amount_min_minor, -1) AND COALESCE(amount_max_minor, 9223372036854775807))) ORDER BY priority ASC LIMIT 1) rule ON true;

assignments.name: review_detail
assignments.value: ={{ { source: 'RULE', account_name: $('Rules Engine').item.json.rule_account_name, account_id: $('Rules Engine').item.json.rule_account_id, note: 'rule maps to PENDING placeholder; needs Craig real account id before posting' } }}
